name: Missing, misused or unverifiable licence or registration
description: Customer offering a regulated or permitted activity cannot evidence the required licence or registration, or operates under a licence held by another party.
fp: Registration data may be out of date or held under a group entity; request documentary evidence.

links.name: Dealer with no licence or with licences used by third parties
links.ctx: Licence-holder 'rents' licence to others or licences conflict with location.

links.name: Licence or permit lacking or misused
links.ctx: Operator lacks the permit or uses another firm's permit for different waste.

links.name: Unlicensed operator or no evidence of registration
links.ctx: Customer offers transfers but cannot evidence registration or supervision.
links.fp: Small agents of licensed principals may hold no own licence.

links.name: Unregistered or recently de-registered organisation soliciting funds
links.ctx: Entity collects donations without evidence of registration, or continues after loss of status, regulatory warning or inquiry.
links.fp: Small community groups may be exempt from registration thresholds.
